utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and whether we’ve got everything loaded properly. Can we double-check the route and the supplies before we head out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — let’s go over the route and do one last check on the supplies before we roll out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that’d help me feel a lot better. Let’s make sure we’ve got the route, tools, and spare parts all set before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive. What time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot. I’m thinking late afternoon, maybe 3:30 to 5:00, if that works around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work for me — I can help cover the pickup window and line up anyone else around 3:30 to 5:00.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet—I’m still waiting on the latest update, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No rush—just send me the update when you get it, and I’ll bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help if you want, just send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Leo — I really appreciate it. I’ll send you the repair drive details in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — what’s left, and where do you want me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries — could you help sort donations by the garage? We still need a hand with the tools and boxes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you start by checking what tools and spare parts we already have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll check the tools and spare parts first, then I’ll let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help, but you may need to remind me what’s needed again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — we’re still gathering tools, spare parts, and a few volunteers for the repair drive. I can send you the list right now if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes please — send me the list, and I’ll do my best to help with whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help me track the needed supplies and sign up a few volunteers? I’ll keep the list organized and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — send me the details, and I’ll help track the supplies and line up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening and which spots are already covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — which spots still need coverage?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the list now — I know the north block is covered, but I still need to confirm the remaining spots.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that repair drive sounds like a good thing—what do they still need from folks?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: They still need tools, a few volunteers, and any spare parts people can donate.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by and drop off a couple of tools, and I might be able to help for an hour too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the update, what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming you’re still good to bring your tools by this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still good — I’ll bring the tools by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Could you help sort the donations by type and label the boxes so we can keep everything organized?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll sort the donations by type and label each box so everything stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in for the repair drive, Pia. Just let me know the time and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — I’ll check the time and make sure we’ve got the right list before I say for sure. If you can bring gloves and a small flashlight, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Pia. I’ll bring gloves and a small flashlight, and I’ll wait for your time update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout so far. I’ll swing by later and drop off what I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is it actually getting a good turnout? I’m not convinced until I see it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’s what I heard — folks have been dropping things off all morning. I’m going by after errands, so I’ll let you know how it looks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll take a quick look and see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo—anything useful helps. I’ll keep a list going for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll swing by if I spot anything useful. Keep me posted on what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. Let me know what you want prioritized first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — let’s prioritize the biggest urgent repairs first, then the safety issues. I’ll help with the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Leo — I’ll start with the urgent repairs and then move straight to the safety issues. Send me your list when you’re ready, and I’ll get it all grouped up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Mara — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and set up the tables at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and set up the tables at the community center. Just tell me when to be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—if you want, I can spread the word about the repair drive to a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be really helpful, Quinn. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll let a few people know today and see who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the repair drive locations—where should we start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be a big help—I've been hearing bits and pieces, so maybe start with the community center and then the bulletin board by the café?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I’ll start with the community center, then check the bulletin board by the café and note anything posted there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll put the repair drive details in your hands and circle back with the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and do my best to follow along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—just tell me what’s needed and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — we need a few hands, some tools, and anyone who can help fix bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out and see who can bring tools or lend a hand. I’ll also ask around for anyone handy with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting pretty good turnout—people are dropping off all kinds of stuff. I’m heading by later to see if they still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great to hear—if they need an extra pair of hands, I can swing by with my toolbox and help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful—your toolbox would probably be a lifesaver. I’ll let you know if they still need help when I get back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the repair drive details before we do anything—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you confirm the date, time, and where we should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm those details now, then I’ll let you know the date, time, and drop-off spot.
